machine.workload: one model at a time under heavy_work_lock profile semantics.analyse:inference; parallel lanes ran full_suite_gate, pytest -n 6 and model jobs concurrently, so latencies carry contention and 3B+ fp32 forwards OOMed

calibration_set.limitation: present-only; no negative examples and no exact event boundaries

comparison_protocol.index: the same existing 1,092-frame CLIP/M2 index, read-only; candidate PE encoders re-embedded those cached JPEGs
comparison_protocol.settings: candidate native checkpoint resolution; common 10-second sampling; frozen query text and frame labels; no score threshold; no model setting tuned on held-out
comparison_protocol.scoring: query-macro sampled-frame Recall@1/5/10, Precision@1/5/10 and Hit@1/5/10; negatives counted for abstention; complete-event temporal recall not derivable from point/frame labels
comparison_protocol.statistical_limit: only four held-out present queries from one synchronized-camera leakage group; treat as pilot evidence, not genre/session-wide confidence

decisions.commercial_first_stage: retain CLIP ViT-L/14: WeMM-2B ties it on the pilot set at higher cost, PE-S improves recall@10 marginally (0.2996 vs 0.2779) without clearing an adoption bar, rerank adds nothing, and 256d shows calibration loss
decisions.personal_options: keep PE Core B/L as research-only measured options; no production integration or model default changed
decisions.thresholds: none calibrated; gaps measured (CLIP 0.0794, PE 0.0322); calibration set has no negatives
decisions.wemm_4b: not run because WeMM 2B did not beat CLIP
decisions.wemm_256d: locally evaluated: 100% held-out retention but calibration recall@10 falls to ~45% of full dim; 87.5% storage saving measured (8.95 MB to 1.12 MB float32); not shippable as default without expanded labels
decisions.resolution: PE-S at 224 px matches/exceeds native 384 px on pilot (recall@10 0.3214 vs 0.2996); native resolution buys nothing measurable
decisions.sampling: 10 s stride retained; 5 s stride worse on pilot
decisions.rerank: no rerank adopted; first-stage ranking stands

existing_comparisons.results: EG2 text-hybrid Recall@5/Precision 0.786/0.161 on Apple 001 and 0.667/0.327 on geo-podcast; EG2 dense 0.768/0.154 and 0.762/0.337. These are text-index/span metrics on a different query set, not comparable with frame-level held-out PE/CLIP numbers.

research_references.notes: NVIDIA describes a joint video/text embedder using 8-frame inputs at 224/336/448 resolutions; its general/action benchmark is not this footage benchmark. No model weights were downloaded.
The approach builds temporal-antonym and negation hard negatives and uses text-only contrastive adaptation; do not claim local performance. No weights were downloaded.
Pinned download + native load verified; upstream embed getters broken, forward path unmeasured under contention; needs audio-grounded cross-modal labels.

BF16 MPS: held-out recall 0.0273/0.1365/0.2729 ties CLIP (0.0278/0.1389/0.2779) at 2.7x storage and ~3 s/query text latency; 256d retains 100% on held-out but ~45% recall@10 on calibration vs full dim. No measured improvement over CLIP.

rerank_experiment.result: no measured rerank gain on the pilot held-out set
rerank_experiment.detail: CLIP-first reranked by PE-S converges to the stronger single model at each depth (depth20: CLIP-level 0.2779; depth50: PE-level 0.2996); PE-first reranked by CLIP likewise. Rerank adds a second model load for zero pilot gain.

threshold_groundwork.result: separation gaps measured; no threshold calibrated
threshold_groundwork.detail: CLIP present-top1 range 0.2111-0.2449 vs negative max 0.1317 (gap 0.0794); PE present-top1 0.2344-0.3351 vs negative max 0.2022 (gap 0.0322). Calibration set has no negatives and held-out negatives are eval-only, so no cutoff was shipped (RET-021).

sampling_experiment.result: denser 5 s stride is worse than 10 s on the pilot set
sampling_experiment.detail: CLIP at 5 s stride over 88 dense M2 frames: recall 0.0223/0.0846/0.174 vs 10 s 0.0278/0.1389/0.2779. Extra frames add near-duplicate distractors that outrank; 10 s retained.

temporal_context_experiment.result: mean-pooled triples concentrate relevance; Hit@k unchanged
temporal_context_experiment.detail: PE-S mean of 3 consecutive stills over 14 held-out triples: recall@10 0.7857 vs still 0.2996, but unit counts differ (14 vs 45) so Recall@k is not directly comparable; Hit@10 is 1.0 both ways. No evidence short clips beat stills. True video-encoder comparison pending (WeMM video forward unmeasured: OOM under contention).

peav_probe.result: mechanics established; quality eval pending labels and adapter
peav_probe.detail: pe-av-small downloaded at pinned revision dd05076 (3.39 GB fp32). Native transformers 5.19 PeAudioVideoModel loads (23-155 s contested) and the processor builds all three modalities, but the upstream get_* embed getters are broken (call nonexistent methods; video getters are unbound __init__ closures). forward() exposes logits_video_text/audio_text/audio_video but the forward probe OOMed under parallel-lane contention. Cross-modal quality needs an audio-grounded label set that does not exist yet.
